blocks.text: 1908 mein English riyazi-daan (mathematician) Godfrey Hardy aur German doctor (physician) Wilhelm Weinberg ne Hardy-Weinberg theorem pesh kiya. Yeh kehta hai ke ek bari population jis mein mating (jore banana) ittefaqi (random) ho, us mein alleles aur genotypes ki frequencies har nasl mein ek jaisi (constant) rehti hain, basharte ke koi evolutionary force (evolution karne wala asar) kaam na kar rahi ho. Is theorem ke mutabiq agar neeche di gayi sharton (conditions) mein se koi ek bhi poori na ho to evolution hota hai.

items: Population ka size bara hona chahiye.
Population ke andar mating ittefaqi (random) honi chahiye: har fard ko kisi bhi doosre fard se mating ka barabar mauqa mile.
Afraad population mein bahar se na aayen aur na bahar jayen (migration na ho).
Mutations na hon. Agar hon to wild-type allele se mutant allele banne wali mutations utni hi hon jitni mutant se wapas wild-type banne wali.
Tamam genotypes ko zinda rehne aur nasl barhane ka barabar mauqa mile.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text:
Gene pool: kisi population mein ek khasiyat (trait) ke tamam genes ki kul tadaad. Misaal: agar population mein phool ke rang ke 1000 genes hain to yahi us ka gene pool hai.
Allele (gene) frequency: population mein kisi khaas allele ki tadaad ya hissa (proportion). Misaal: agar 1000 genes mein se 600 surkh rang ke hain to surkh allele ki frequency 0.6 (60%) hai.
Genotype frequency: kisi khaas genotype wale afraad ki tadaad ya hissa. Misaal: agar 100 paudon mein se 40 RR hain to RR ki genotype frequency 0.4 (40%) hai.
